meetings.headline: Council on Aging voted to ask that a COA member take an active part in interviewing the new director.
meetings.summary: The Council on Aging, at its first televised meeting, objected to being shut out of the interviews for the retiring director's replacement and voted to ask for an active representative. The director presented a revolving fund article for special town meeting to support the senior lunch kitchen. The board also covered the volunteer cookout, capital plan and building items, upcoming events, and then went into executive session.

budget_items.topic: Special town meeting article: senior kitchen revolving fund
budget_items.what_was_said: The director and the town accountant drafted an article for a revolving fund to buy food for the three-day-a-week lunch program. Lunch fees would be turned over weekly.

budget_items.topic: Revolving fund initial funding from town budget
budget_items.what_was_said: Initial funding would come from the town budget and be replenished by receipts. It would be a new line voted each year at town meeting, similar to the revolving fund for the van service.
Participants are charged a small fee for lunch and breakfast, and receipts would reimburse the account.
The director will not apply for grants to replenish the fund. If the amount proves too small, she would return to town meeting.
The director expects the outlook to be poor but will still request more hours for the van site manager position.

budget_items.topic: Town financial condition and free cash
budget_items.what_was_said: A member disputed the claim that the town is in poor financial shape, citing free cash left over in recent years and one-time uses of it.
A requested purchase was withdrawn from the office submissions for lack of a vendor, and a ballpark estimate has since come in. The library director reportedly got a quote for a smaller area.
Bids came in over the capital plan amount, but the low bid was not much over. The facilities manager and the interim town manager are looking for funds.

budget_items.topic: Parking lot engineering request in capital plan
budget_items.what_was_said: Old plans are unusable, and members urged the facilities manager to keep the prior engineering request in the capital plan so it keeps its history.

budget_items.topic: Building maintenance and utilities cost comparison
budget_items.what_was_said: A member said another building costs a lot to maintain and run, and asked the director to ask the facilities manager what is budgeted for this busier building. Capital plan items have a minimum threshold.
Participants pay a small amount and the COA covers the rest from its programs budget.

budget_items.topic: Annual funding request to the supporters group
budget_items.what_was_said: The director will ask the supporters group for annual funding for memory cafe and entertainment.

decisions.decision: Members agreed to express push back as a council when submitting questions for the director interview, and to take a vote in support.

The director will request an increase in van site manager hours, from 24 to 26, if budget information arrives in time.
The 300th celebration item will come off the agenda until about 2027.
Members agreed to review the resource guide as a board once everyone has had time to read it.
The next meeting was set for Tuesday October 8th at 9:30.

what_happened.line: The Council on Aging voted to ask that a council member be present and active in interviewing the retiring director's replacement.
The director presented a draft special town meeting article for a revolving fund to buy food for the three-day-a-week senior lunch program.
Under the draft, initial funding would come from the town budget and be replenished by lunch fees, as a new line voted each year at town meeting.
Roof replacement bids came in over the capital plan amount; the facilities manager and interim town manager are looking for funds.
The director plans to request more van site manager hours in the FY26 budget, if budget information arrives in time.

why_it_matters: The revolving fund would be a new article on a special town meeting warrant, so voters may be asked to approve it and to renew it each year.
The roof bids over the capital plan amount could put a senior center building repair on a funding list that town officials have not yet settled.
watch_next: Special town meeting warrant for the senior kitchen revolving fund article.
